Fixture — button-name-present

This file includes a wide range of cases for the button accessible-name presence rule. Your rule should focus on presence only, and should treat aria-hidden="true" and [hidden] descendants as not contributing to content-derived names.

aria-label present but empty

Expected: PASS or FAIL?
If your accessible-name helper treats empty aria-label as "no programmatic name", the fallback content should pass here because aria-hidden="false" provides content text. If your helper treats empty aria-label as authoritative empty name, you may see FAIL. Preferred behavior (presence-focused): PASS.
